title: Ilya Mourometz
description: A colorful account of Ilya Mourometz, the legendary 11th-century hero who defended Russia from monsters and invaders.

title: Ruslan and Ludmilla
description: A warrior battles sorcerers, witches and an evil dwarf in order to rescue his princess bride (Natal'ya Petrova).

title: The Tale of Tsar Saltan
description: When Tsar Saltan is away at war, the scheming members of his court exile his young wife and newborn heir.

title: The Grindhouse
description:
S01 E01 — Asylum
Robert Bloch, the man responsible for writing the novel of one of horror's greatest movies, Psycho (1960), writes for us four intriguing and pleasurable short horror pieces bound together wonderfully in the confines of an asylum.

title: Housebound
description: A would-be thief (Morgana O'Reilly) is remanded to the custody of her estranged mother (Rima Te Wiata), who turns out to be correct in her assertion that evil spirits are afoot in their family domicile.

title: The Grand Duel
description: A mysterious gunfighter (Lee Van Cleef) protects a man accused of killing an Arizona big shot.

title: Django
description: Stranger Django (Franco Nero) rides into the middle of a border fray between Mexican bandits and the Ku Klux Klan.

title: Run Man Run
description: An unlucky thief makes a friend in prison and from there goes hunting for buried gold.

title: The Dark Valley
description: In 19th-century Austria, war erupts between a traveler (Sam Riley) and a local family after one of their members dies under mysterious circumstances.

title: The Undefeated
description: A Union colonel (John Wayne) with a herd of cattle crosses paths with an ex-Confederate colonel's (Rock Hudson) gang in Mexico.

title: Return of Shanghai Joe
description: Shanghai Joe (Cheen Lie) and a friendly snake-oil salesman take on a sinister town boss (Klaus Kinski) who uses violence on those who oppose his demands.

title: Django, Kill ... If You Live, Shoot!
description: The infamous outlaw Django vows revenge after he is betrayed and left for dead during a gold robbery.

title: Minnesota Clay
description: A gunfighter (Cameron Mitchell) who is going blind escapes from prison for a showdown with an enemy (Georges Rivière) he can only hear.

title: Don't Open the Door
description: A young woman (Susan Bracken) visiting her grandmother realizes there is a killer in the house.

title: The White Reindeer
description: A shaman turns a newlywed woman into a vampiric white reindeer after she seeks his help.

title: Leptirica
description: A group of rural villagers is beset upon by the infamous vampire Sava Savanovic, who has taken up residence in the local flour mill.

title: I Bury the Living
description: The chairman (Richard Boone) of a cemetery thinks a person dies when he moves their pin on a plot chart.

title: The Last Island
description: Five men and two women, marooned survivors of an air crash, discover that they may be the only survivors of a world disaster.

title: The Killing Floor
description: The story of a slaughterhouse worker (Damien Leake) and union trouble culminates in the Chicago race riot of 1919.

title: The Final Countdown
description: A time warp takes the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz and its captain (Kirk Douglas) back to Pearl Harbor, Dec. 6, 1941.

title: The Case Is Closed: Forget It
description: An architect ends up in prison for manslaughter and discovers the harsh reality behind bars, made up of rules, protections and criminal organizations.

title: Shin Ultraman
description: After the accidental death of a human during battle, Ultraman takes on the man's appearance and place at the S-Class Species Suppression Protocol to protect Earth from further threats.

title: Hollywood Dreams & Nightmares: The Robert Englund Story
description: Classically trained actor Robert Englund becomes a horror icon with his portrayal of Freddy Krueger, the burned, razor-clawed boogeyman in the "Nightmare on Elm Street" franchise.

title: Lake Michigan Monster
description: An eccentric ship captain and a crew of specialists plot revenge against the most mysterious creature of the deep -- the Lake Michigan Monster.

title: Blood Hook
description: A killer tries to snag a Wisconsin teen and his friends during a "Muskie Madness" fishing contest.

title: Embryo
description: A doctor (Rock Hudson) bypasses nature with growth hormones, producing a 22-year-old (Barbara Carrera) who becomes his lover.

title: Wing Chun
description: A Chinese woman (Michelle Yeoh) uses martial arts to defeat horse thieves and win respect from village men.

title: Treasure Inn
description: Two police officers in White Horse City have amazing and underused skills. They join forces with twin sisters to investigate the murder of a family and the theft of a relic.

title: The Dragon, the Hero
description: A kung-fu fighter goes back to Hong Kong to help a friend fight gangsters.

title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Assassin on the Road to Hell
description: The story of a warrior named Ogami Itto and his son comes full circle.

title: Deadend of Besiegers
description: A martial-arts expert helps Chinese villagers thwart pirates' theft of their town's priceless pearl.

title: Avenging Boxer
description: A youth studies the martial arts in order to avenge his father's death and retrieve a sacred golden plate.

title: Never Say Never
description: A former boxing champion decides to break a few rules and train orphans from China's remote countryside to fight to give them a future.

title: Raining in the Mountain
description: A general and an esquire employ martial artists to steal a scroll hidden in the monastery's library.

title: Gamera: The Guardian of the Universe
description: The giant turtle is awakened from his long slumber to protect Japan from a rival monster's destructive power.

title: The Tag-Along: The Devil Fish
description: Two students secretly record an exorcism and accidentally release the spirit back into the world.
